caption: The drawing depicts a closed, large, dark brown book with a marbled texture and visible signs of wear and creases. The book features a gold circular emblem in the center of the cover, which displays the Great Seal of the United States including an eagle with spread wings, a striped shield over its chest, an olive branch in its right talon, and a bundle of arrows in its left talon. Above the eagle’s head, there is a cluster of stars encircled by a cloud. There is a banner reading "E PLURIBUS UNUM" in the eagle’s beak and the words "THE PRESIDENTS" are inscribed in gold along the lower edge of the emblem. The edges of the book’s cover are bordered with thin yellow-gold lines, and the corners contain gold filigree designs. The book is angled slightly to the right atop a cream-colored background, and another book with a similarly ornate edge is partially visible beneath it. The artist's name, "WAYNE WHITE," appears printed in small text at the lower left of the image.
title: Book with U.S. Seal on Cover
